meta.description: Quantifies CRISPResso2 editing outcomes for Cas9, base-editor, prime-editor, batch, pooled, WGS, and comparison workflows.
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated results or unverifiable live-result claim was made; blocked container outcomes are recorded as blocked.

practice_boundaries.detail: The Skill supports research assay quantification and advises validation rather than individual diagnosis or treatment.

methodological_ground.detail: Mode selection, quantification-window cautions, NA checks, and expected hard-failure behavior are scientifically appropriate.

code_usability.detail: scripts/parse_crispresso.py passed its self-test and py_compile; the shipped shell script passed bash -n. CRISPResso2 container execution is externally blocked, not treated as a pass.

functional_suitability.note: All stated CRISPResso2 modes have a route, with a small limitation that live final-pass evidence could not cover them.

reliability.note: Concrete failure modes, NA checks, and recovery directions are strong; live container retry remains external.

performance_context.note: References and scripts keep the main guide compact; genome-scale resource expectations could be more explicit.

agent_usability.note: Decision tree, exact paths, commands, and failure modes are clear; some placeholders require assay-specific values.

human_usability.note: Natural triggers and recovery text are present; field-convention thresholds should carry stronger source attribution.

security.note: No secrets or destructive commands are present; FASTQ and file-path inputs are researcher-controlled rather than programmatically validated.

maintainability.note: Mode-specific references and a self-testing parser provide clean, testable separation.

agent_specific.note: Precise triggering and progressive disclosure are good; a few interpretation thresholds remain heuristic rather than machine-checkable.

key_strengths: The fixed Skill separates concise mode routing from focused base-editor, prime-editor, and batch/pooled/WGS references.
The parser is a real shipped, self-testing program and correctly computes mapping_pct from the current CRISPResso2 mapping schema.
The documentation directly guards the formerly silent pooled-NA output, wrong-locus hard failure, quality-filter effect, and invalid CRISPRessoCompare flag form.

recommendations.title: Restore Docker execution and rerun core modes
recommendations.problem: The Docker daemon answered version requests but newly created CRISPResso containers never reached start; docker cp and a 45-second CRISPResso --version probe timed out. Fresh core CLI outputs therefore could not be checked.
recommendations.root_cause: Shared Docker Desktop container-start path is unavailable in this audit session, not a defect in the Skill bytes.
recommendations.fix: Restore the Docker container-start path without disrupting unrelated containers, then rerun run/run_dynamic.ps1 and require the generated validation.json to pass before changing deployable to true.

recommendations.title: Cite interpretation thresholds more precisely
recommendations.problem: Several numerical editing and bystander thresholds are labelled field convention or application-dependent without per-threshold source links.
recommendations.root_cause: Threshold table summarizes practice guidance more compactly than its evidence base.
recommendations.fix: Add direct citations or clearly mark each threshold as project-specific QC guidance in the quantitative-thresholds table.
